tasks.subject: Task 1: Flip optional macOS slice to x86_64 in make-swiftgodot-framework
tasks.description:
**Goal:** make-swiftgodot-framework treats $derived_data (arm64) as primary macOS slice and ${derived_data}_x86 as optional secondary.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/make-swiftgodot-framework"], "verifyCommand": "bash -n scripts/make-swiftgodot-framework && scripts/test-make-swiftgodot-framework", "acceptanceCriteria": ["bd_mac_arm renamed to bd_mac_x86", "${derived_data}_arm to ${derived_data}_x86", "bd_mac unchanged", "no other changes"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 2: Gate build-x86 job behind workflow_dispatch input
tasks.description:
**Goal:** release.yml gains include_macos_x86 input; build-x86 runs only when true; release job tolerates skipped build-x86 and swaps macOS staging dirs.

```json:metadata
{"files": [".github/workflows/release.yml"], "verifyCommand": "python3 -c \"import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/release.yml'))\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["include_macos_x86 input", "build-x86 gated", "release job if tolerates skip", "staging dirs swapped", "env mapped 1/empty"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 3: Make x86_64 opt-in in scripts/release
tasks.description:
**Goal:** scripts/release always builds/validates arm64 macOS as primary, handles x86_64 only when SWIFT_GODOT_INCLUDE_MACOS_X86 set.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/release"], "verifyCommand": "bash -n scripts/release", "acceptanceCriteria": ["env var parsed", "usage documents it", "build path swapped", "SKIP_BUILD validation swapped"]}
```

tasks.subject: Task 4: Make macro artifact bundle x86_64 opt-in
tasks.description:
**Goal:** build-macro-artifactbundle builds arm64-only by default, universal when SWIFT_GODOT_INCLUDE_MACOS_X86 set; swift.yml macro step keeps exercising universal.

```json:metadata
{"files": ["scripts/build-macro-artifactbundle", ".github/workflows/swift.yml"], "verifyCommand": "bash -n scripts/build-macro-artifactbundle && python3 -c \"import yaml; yaml.safe_load(open('.github/workflows/swift.yml'))\"", "acceptanceCriteria": ["env var parsed", "universal when set", "arm64-only when unset", "swift.yml step sets the env"]}
```
